business_summary: Bajaj HealthCare Limited, a pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, markets, and sells active pharmaceutical ingredient, intermediates, and finished dosage forms and nutraceuticals for pharmaceutical, nutraceuticals, and food industries in India and internationally. The company offers active pharmaceutical ingredient in various therapeutic categories, including anthelmintic, anti viral, anti coagulant, vitamin c, anti arthritis, atypical antipsychotic agent, anti convulsant, vasoprotective, disinfectant, anti asthamatic, neuro protective, anti histamine, iron chelator, vasoprotective, urinary tract infection, anti migraine, anti rheumatic, antibiotic, anti tussive, weight reducing, hemorheologic agent, vasodilator, anti psychotic, beta agonist, gastroretentive drug, and antagonist. It also provides 2-amino-3,5-dibromobenzaldehyde, bromoethyl theophylline, calcium phosphoryl choline chloride, 4-hydrazinobenzoic acid and octopamine HCL, 8- chloro theophylline, chlorohexanone, theobromine, hesperidin, 5-amino-2,4,6-triiodoisophthaloyl dichloride, 3-methyl xanthine, 3-methyl-7-(2-butyn-1-yl)-8- bromo xanthine, 8 bromo-3-methyl xanthine, 4,5-dinitroaniline, 4,5-dichloro-2-nitroaniline, and 2-amino -4- hydroxyacetophenone. In addition, it offers nutraceuticals; and formulations in the form of tablets, capsules, sachets, and vials, as well as impurities. Bajaj HealthCare Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Thane, India.
